From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>

Subject: Post-call: RidgePay throughput & latency alignment + ops checklist

Hi Amit / Elena —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap to make sure we’re aligned and to capture the technical asks before the deep dive: 

Summary of customer goals
- Replace in-house scoring service with low-latency reranking for fraud scoring and transaction enrichment.
- Target: p95 generation latency <= 200ms for single-turn scoring calls under steady state.
- Throughput: ~120 requests per second peak (each request ~150 tokens average), spiky traffic around payroll runs.

Primary pain points discussed
- Current service has high tail latency during batch spikes and unpredictable queueing.
- Cost per inference is high due to lack of batching and inefficient GPU utilization.
- Need for auditability: per-request logs and retention (30–90 days) for compliance.

Model & workload constraints we noted
- Model must be instruction-following with deterministic outputs for scoring (they prefer a smaller, tuned open model).
- Context window: up to 8k but typical requests use <512 tokens.
- We discussed quantized 4-bit model variants for cost, but they need a quality check vs. fp16.

Suggested topology & SLOs (initial recommendation)
- Deployment: Redwood Dedicated pool in us-west with autoscale headroom for payroll spikes.
- Routing: dedicate a latency-first pool for scoring path; cheaper batch pool for async enrichment.
- Caching: prefix/KV caching for repeated transaction contexts; 30-minute TTL for identical hashes.
- Batching policy: conservative continuous batching (<=50ms hold) to preserve p95 under 200ms.

Immediate next steps (owner in parentheses)
1) Share sample traffic traces + 1k example queries (Amit) — we can use these to run microbenchmarks.
2) Redwood to provide a topology sketch + capacity estimate (Marissa / Rishi) — see attached draft.
3) Schedule a 75-minute tech deep-dive with RidgePay infra, security, and ML infra (Grace to coordinate).
4) Provide SOC2 audit evidence & retention options (Rishi to attach).

Attachments: redwood-topology-draft.pdf (topology sketch), sample-queries-1klines.csv (anonymized), ops-checklist-v1.xlsx

If that matches your notes, can we lock the tech deep-dive for next week? I’m proposing Tue 11/10 10:00–11:15 PT — if that doesn’t work, drop a few times.

Thanks,
Marissa
